verdict.rationale: Shortwave's own docs describe an AI assistant that can 'search your entire email history, check your calendar', which covers cross-inbox and calendar questions. Community reports note that on the free plan, mail older than 90 days isn't searchable, which limits 'whole inbox' coverage. missing for 10: documentation that answers are grounded with citations or source threads, explicit evidence for 'who said what' and outstanding-item queries, independent hands-on corroboration of assistant Q&A quality, and full-history coverage on the free tier.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can ask an assistant questions across my whole inbox and calendar — who said what, what's outstanding — and get grounded answers

citations.quote: it can read threads, write drafts, search your entire email history, check your calendar, and more
Connect the AI to your Slack, Calendar, Notion, Asana, Hubspot, and more
On the free plan, emails older than 90 days don't appear in search and pre-signup history beyond 90 days isn't imported.
